bajada: In a large organization, the spreadsheet has the data but not the org chart, the drawing falls behind at the first change, and a cloud service leaves your people's records on another company's servers. BoldoAtlas brings the tree, the positions and the records together in a database on your computer.

cifras.texto: people, 1,000 of them with a photo

nota: Measured on Windows 11, from opening the app to seeing the totals on Home, with a test organization and generated portraits: 0.6 to 0.9 s with optimized or 300 KB photos. The first opening of each folder takes longer because it makes a backup.

items.titulo: The whole structure on one canvas
items.texto: Each card shows the unit's head, the team's faces, the headcount and the vacancies.
puntos: Branches fold away, and the 1, 2, 3 and All buttons choose how many levels you see.
Lateral connections between units: dotted lines with their description, through the free space between cards.
Several trees in one database, and any branch opens as a tree of its own.
Zones with a name and a color that group units from any branch, without changing who reports to whom.
Saved views, and highlighting by tag or by text.

imagen.leyenda: The sample organization that comes with the app (16 people)
imagen.alt: Sample org chart: General Management with Operations, Finance and People; Operations open down to Maintenance, Production, Mechanical and Electrical, with heads, headcount and vacancies.

items.titulo: Every person's record, tied to their position
items.texto: Each position knows who holds it and who covers it. The record keeps contact, contract, site and shift, with the position history.
puntos: Vacancies in plain sight on every card of the tree.
Your own lists of job titles, contracts, sites and shifts.
Photos are reduced when you choose them: they look the same and weigh much less, in backups and .boldo files too.

imagen.alt: Person record for Andrés Soto: name, email, the unit he heads, his Manager position with its history, contract type, site and shift.

items.etiqueta: The org chart on any date
items.titulo: Look at another day without changing anything
items.texto: Pick or type a date and see who held each position that day, read-only.
puntos: Days with changes are marked on the calendar.
Jump to the previous or next change.
The list of what changed that day: who took over and who covered.

imagen.alt: The org chart as of September 1, 2026, read-only, with the calendar open and that day's change.

enlace.texto: Read how to view a past date

comparar.texto: We reviewed Visio, Lucidchart, draw.io, OrgChart, Buk and Talana on their official sites: criterion by criterion, with the source of every data point.
